title: Exponential remainder
hints: The first derivative quotient is still $0/0$.
Differentiate again and keep both inner factors.
solution: The successive quotients are $([$a]e^{[$a]x}-[$a])/(2x)$ and $[$a]^2e^{[$a]x}/2$. The second tends to $[$a]^2/2$.
